notes.title: Studio BBB’s First Steam Community Post: Meet MONOWAVE

notes.title: Wrapping Up MONOWAVE's Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750123/2a8a249854190a58864430da92fe86f3e65106ab.png[/img]
MONOWAVE has successfully wrapped up Steam Next Fest! Participating in this global event meant we could connect with users from all over the world—not just Korea—through Steam. We're thrilled to report that MONOWAVE attracted over 70,000 cumulative viewers and hit a peak of 1,100 concurrent viewers—far exceeding our expectations. We're incredibly grateful for the support and are excited to continue developing MONOWAVE. Thank you for your enthusiasm and interest in our game! 

📢 A Note on Our Steam Demo:
The demo will remain available on Steam until the end of June. We are committed to improving it based on your valuable feedback. Keep an eye out for updates and see how MONOWAVE evolves! 

We invite you to share any further feedback on the Steam Community forums. Your input is crucial in helping us refine MONOWAVE.

Visit our Steam Community here:

https://steamcommunity.com/app/2680440/discussions/

Thank you once again for being a part of Mono’s journey during the Steam Next Fest!

notes.title: MONOWAVE: LIVE STREAM @STEAM NEXT FEST
notes.notes:
[h1] Join us for a MONOWAVE Livestream Event at STEAM NEXT FEST! [/h1]

Hello, Steam Community!

For the first time ever, MONOWAVE is hosting a live streaming event at STEAM NEXT FEST. The developers will be playing the MONOWAVE demo and hosting a Q&A session where you can ask them any questions you have about the game.

🎮 [b]What is MONOWAVE? [/b]
MONOWAVE is a puzzle adventure game about emotions, with a demo currently available on STEAM. You can try World 1, which is a quarter of the full game, for free! If you haven't played it yet, here's your chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750123/4ff8765c166fa0b25dd3923d4fb0118b9abf77eb.jpg[/img]

[b]Live Stream Details: [/b]
There will be two live streaming sessions:

- [b]Second session: [/b] June 16, 5:00 PST

Each session will start with a live demo playthrough, followed by a Q&A session where viewers can ask questions about the game. Ask everything you want to know about MONOWAVE.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750123/0b9e2f5507eab4360db3cfd8cb933f0915bc7834.png[/img]

[b]How to participate: [/b]
Click the link below to go to our STEAM page and watch the live stream! If you haven't played the demo yet, go play it now!
🎮 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680440/_/]PLAY THE MONOWAVE DEMO![/url]

We're really looking forward to this event, as it will allow us to interact directly with players and share what we're working on. Your feedback will play a very important role in our development.

Thank you for your interest and support. We look forward to seeing you there!

- This stream will be available in Korean, English, and Japanese.
- This streaming will focus on Korean and Japanese. English communication is also possible.

notes.title: MONOWAVE Demoplay Broadcast
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44750123/4ff8765c166fa0b25dd3923d4fb0118b9abf77eb.jpg[/img]

[h3]Check out MONOWAVE Demoplay at STEAM NEXT FEST! [/h3]

Hello Steam Community, this is BBB, the developers of MONOWAVE!
[b]We're excited to announce that we'll be streaming a demo of MONOWAVE starting June 10 at 10:00 (PST) AM during STEAM NEXT FEST![/b]

The demo play streams will feature footage of our team members playing the demo.

If you're curious about what MONOWAVE is like, this stream will give you a great sense of the game's overall feel and gameplay.

This stream will feature the same version of the demo that is available on STEAM.
If you want to try MONOWAVE after watching, you can download and play the demo on STEAM.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680440/_/]▶️Play the Demo!◀️[/url]

Demo play stream schedule:
[b]Details:[/b]

[list]
[*] Starting June 10, 2024, at 10:00 (PST)

[*] Until the end of STEAM NEXT FEST
[/list]
(*Demo play footage will not be available on June 15 and 16 during the live stream.)

We look forward to seeing everyone in the Steam community!

You can also watch the demo on Studio BBB's YouTube channel.
